output.patientMessage: Please call 911 now for emergency transport to the hospital — do not try to stand or walk on that leg, and don't drive yourself. A fall with severe hip pain and inability to put weight on the leg can mean a broken hip, which needs X-rays (and sometimes further scans) and orthopedic care today. If you can, have someone stay with you until help arrives. Tell the crew if you hit your head, blacked out, or take blood thinners.
